description: Evaluates whether The2410 can build the custom software project a customer describes. Use it when a customer describes a new project or request. Returns fit, relevant services or solutions, indicative pricing, a project_context_id and next_actions for the project tools. If the request is only a small task, returns route = small_task and the URL of the separate Human Tasks by The2410 connector. This is not a detailed project plan or a contractual estimate.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, for example EUR or USD.

desired_timeline.description: Desired delivery timeframe, for example "4-6 months".

project_context_id.description: Omit for a new project. To continue an existing project, send the exact UUID returned by a previous call.

request_description.description: The customer's request as written, in any language: what they need, platform, constraints and main requirements.

name: analyze-request-tool
title: Analyze request
